mapper.insert: INSERT INTO oms_fulfillment_package ( package_id, plan_id, warehouse_id, warehouse_code, carrier_id, carrier_code, carrier_name, destination_country, service_level, status, total_quantity, total_amount, estimated_shipping_cost, estimated_delivery_days, note, shipment_id, tracking_no, shipped_at, platform_sync_status, platform_sync_attempts, platform_sync_error, platform_synced_at ) VALUES ( #{packageId}, #{planId}, #{warehouseId}, #{warehouseCode}, #{carrierId}, #{carrierCode}, #{carrierName}, #{destinationCountry}, #{serviceLevel}, #{status}, #{totalQuantity}, #{totalAmount}, #{estimatedShippingCost}, #{estimatedDeliveryDays}, #{note}, #{shipmentId}, #{trackingNo}, #{shippedAt}, #{platformSyncStatus}, #{platformSyncAttempts}, #{platformSyncError}, #{platformSyncedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT package_id, plan_id, warehouse_id, warehouse_code, carrier_id, carrier_code, carrier_name, destination_country, service_level, status, total_quantity, total_amount, estimated_shipping_cost, estimated_delivery_days, note, shipment_id, tracking_no, shipped_at, platform_sync_status, platform_sync_attempts, platform_sync_error, platform_synced_at FROM oms_fulfillment_package WHERE plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY package_id ASC
SELECT package_line_id, package_id, order_line_id, seller_sku, title, quantity, unit_price, line_amount FROM oms_fulfillment_package_line WHERE package_id = #{packageId} ORDER BY package_line_id ASC
